forms.summaryTitle: A few fields need attention before you can continue

unreachable.title: The server cannot be reached
unreachable.body: Your request never reached the server, so nothing was sent and nothing has changed.
unreachable.action: Check your internet connection and try again in a few moments.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: One account can hold several organizations. You will add the first one after you confirm your email address.
register.emailHelp: We send the confirmation link here. Notifications will arrive here too.
register.emailMissing: The email address is missing, so there is nowhere to send the confirmation link. Fill in the address before continuing.
register.emailInvalid: What you entered is not shaped like an email address, so the confirmation link would go nowhere. Check the address and correct it.
register.pasteHint: A password manager and pasting from the clipboard both work here.

requirements.further: At least one other character — a symbol, a space, anything else

register.passwordPolicy: The password you chose does not meet all the requirements shown, so the account was not created. Complete every item on the list — between {minimum} and {maximum} characters, with a lowercase letter, an uppercase letter, a digit and one further character.
register.problemTitle: The request could not be processed
register.problemBody: The account was not created because the request could not be processed.

verify.title: Confirm your email address
verify.sentIntro: We sent a confirmation link to
verify.instructions: Open the link on any device. It works once and expires after 24 hours. You can close this page without worry — nothing is lost.
verify.sentBody: If this address holds an account awaiting confirmation, a new link is on its way.
verify.sentAction: Check your inbox, including the spam folder.
verify.enterEmailIntro: Enter the address you registered with and we will send you a fresh confirmation link.
verify.emailMissing: The email address is missing, so there is nowhere to send the new link. Fill in the address before sending.
verify.emailInvalid: What you entered is not shaped like an email address, so the link would go nowhere. Check the address and correct it.
verify.confirmIntro: Press the button below to confirm the address and activate your account. The link works only once.
verify.successBody: Your account is active. From here you can sign in and create your organization.
verify.problemTitle: The link could not be used
verify.problemBody: The address was not confirmed because the request could not be processed.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Sign in to your account to work on your organizations' reports.
signIn.emailMissing: The email address is missing, so we do not know which account to open. Fill in the address before continuing.
signIn.emailInvalid: The text entered is not shaped like an email address, so sign-in cannot start. Check the address and correct it.
signIn.passwordMissing: The password is missing, so we cannot verify your identity. Fill in the password before continuing.
signIn.problemBody: We could not sign you in because of an error while processing the request.

factor.title: Confirm it's you
factor.subtitle: Your password was correct. One code more and we'll open your account.
factor.codeHelp: Six digits, which change every thirty seconds.
factor.codeMissing: The code is missing, so we can't confirm it's you. Open your authenticator app and enter the code showing now.
factor.expiresIn: {minutes, plural, one {One minute left} other {# minutes left}}
factor.recoveryHelp: One of the ten codes you were given when you turned on the extra step. Each one works once.
factor.recoveryMissing: The recovery code is missing, so we can't confirm it's you. Enter one of the codes you saved when you turned the extra step on.
factor.summaryTitle: The field below needs attention before you can continue
factor.problemBody: We couldn't confirm the code, so your account stays closed.
factor.useRecovery: No access to the app? Use a recovery code
factor.useAuthenticator: Back to the code from the app
factor.lapsedBody: More than five minutes have passed since you entered your password, so this confirmation is no longer valid and your account stays closed.

resetRequest.title: Reset your password
resetRequest.subtitle: We will email you a link from which you set a new password.
resetRequest.emailHelp: The address you registered with. That is where the reset link goes.
resetRequest.emailMissing: The email address is missing, so there is nowhere to send the reset link. Fill in the address before sending.
resetRequest.emailInvalid: The text entered is not shaped like an email address, so the link would not reach anyone. Check the address and correct it.
resetRequest.sentBody: If the address has an account, a reset link is on its way. It works once and expires after 60 minutes.
resetRequest.sentAction: Check your inbox, including the spam folder.
resetRequest.problemTitle: The request could not be processed
resetRequest.problemBody: The reset link was not sent because of an error while processing the request.

setPassword.title: Set a new password
setPassword.subtitle: Choose the new password for your account.
setPassword.consequenceTitle: All existing sessions will be signed out
setPassword.consequenceBody: When you save the new password, you are automatically signed out on every device where you are signed in. You sign in again with the new password.
setPassword.consequenceAction: Save the new password only when you are ready to sign in again.
setPassword.successBody: All existing sessions have been signed out. From here you can sign in with the new password.
setPassword.problemTitle: The link could not be used
setPassword.problemBody: The password was not changed because of an error while processing the request.
setPassword.missingBody: The address you opened does not carry the reset code, so we do not know which account to change. Open the link exactly as it arrived in the email, or request a new one.

cancelled.title: Sign-in interrupted
cancelled.body: The provider sign-in was cancelled before it finished, so you were not signed in.
cancelled.action: Choose the provider again, or use your email address and password.

restart.title: Start the sign-in again
restart.body: The provider sign-in step expired or could not be verified, so you were not signed in.
restart.action: Start the provider sign-in again from the beginning.

unavailable.title: Sign-in method unavailable
unavailable.body: Signing in through this provider is not available right now, so the account can only be reached the other ways.
unavailable.action: Use your email address and password, or try again later.

failed.title: Provider sign-in unsuccessful
failed.body: The provider sign-in could not be completed, so you were not signed in.
failed.action: Try again; if it keeps failing, use your email address and password.

emailInUse.title: An account with this address already exists
emailInUse.body: The address the provider confirmed belongs to an existing account, and a provider sign-in cannot take over an existing account.
emailInUse.action: Sign in with the account's password, using the form below.

verifySent.title: Confirm your email address
verifySent.body: Your account was created, but the email address is not confirmed yet. We have sent you a message with the confirmation link.
verifySent.action: Open the confirmation screen if the message has not arrived.

unknownIdentity.title: No account for this identity
unknownIdentity.body: The provider account is not linked to any account on the platform, so there is nothing to sign in to yet.
unknownIdentity.action: Create a new account with the provider's button below, or with your email address.

organizationUnavailable.title: We could not load your organisations
organizationUnavailable.body: You are signed in, but the list of organisations you belong to could not be retrieved, so the workspace cannot be opened yet. Try again in a moment; if it keeps happening, sign out and come back later.

invitation.title: You have been invited
invitation.signedOutIntro: You need an easyesg account to accept this invitation. Create one now, or sign in if you already have one — we will bring you straight back here.
invitation.acceptIntro: Accepting joins you to {organization} with the role “{role}”. You can start work straight away.
invitation.problemTitle: The invitation could not be accepted
invitation.problemBody: Something stopped the invitation being accepted, so you have not been added to the organisation. Refresh the page and try again.
invitation.wrongAccountTitle: The invitation is for another address
invitation.wrongAccountBody: The invitation was sent to {invited} and you are signed in as {current}, so this account cannot use it. Sign out and sign in with the invited address.
invitation.signInAsInvited: Sign out and sign in as {invited}
invitation.wrongAccountAlternative: If you would rather use your current address, ask an administrator of the organisation for an invitation to it.

expired.title: Invitation out of time
expired.body: This invitation has run out of time, so the link no longer works and you have not been added to the organisation. Ask an administrator of the organisation to send it again — you will get a fresh link, good for another 7 days.

consumed.title: Invitation already used
consumed.body: This invitation has already been used, so the link no longer works. If you accepted it yourself, sign in; otherwise ask an administrator of the organisation for a new invitation.

revoked.title: Invitation withdrawn
revoked.body: An administrator of the organisation withdrew this invitation, so you have not been added. If that was a mistake, ask them to invite you again.

unknown.title: Link not recognised
unknown.body: This link does not match any invitation, so you have not been added to an organisation. Check that you copied all of it from the email, or ask for a new invitation.

credentials.title: Sign-in details
credentials.lede: How you get into your account, and which ways you have. Keep at least one working.

password.heading: Password
password.description: Changing your password requires the one in force now.
password.terminate: Sign out of your other devices
password.terminateHelp: The device you are making the change on stays signed in.
password.nextMissing: Enter the new password, or the change cannot be made.
password.doneBody: Use the new password the next time you sign in.
password.doneWithSessions: Your password was changed and your other sessions were ended.

factor.heading: Two-step verification
factor.description: A code from your authenticator app, asked for every time you sign in.
factor.noCodesTitle: You have no recovery codes left
factor.noCodesBody: Two-step verification stays on, but if you lose access to your authenticator app you will have no way back into your account.
factor.secretHelp: Add it to your authenticator app, then enter the code the app shows below.
factor.codeMissing: Enter the code from the app, or setting this up cannot be completed.
factor.enabledBody: You will be asked for a code every time you sign in from now on.
factor.disabledBody: Signing in needs your password only again.
factor.codesHelp: We show these once. Keep them somewhere safe — each one works once, for when you do not have your phone.
factor.codesBody: Your previous codes no longer work.

providers.heading: Linked accounts
providers.description: You can sign in with one of these as well as with your password.
providers.confirmHelp: Enter your current password to confirm. Without it, the account is not linked.
providers.linkedBody: You can use it to sign in from now on.
providers.unlinkedBody: You can no longer use it to sign in.

confirm.heading: Confirm these changes
confirm.help: The changes above require your current password. If you only sign in through a linked account, leave this empty.

unreachable.title: This section could not be loaded
unreachable.body: The details could not be read, so this section cannot be used right now. Reload the page to try again.

credentials.unreachableBody: No answer came back, so nothing was changed. Try again.

create.title: Set up your organisation
create.subtitle: This is the company the report is filed for. You become its administrator and can invite colleagues as soon as it exists.
create.nameHelp: Exactly as it appears in the state register. It prints on the report.
create.nameRequired: Enter the company’s legal name, or the organisation cannot be created.
create.nameTooLong: The name is longer than 200 characters and cannot be saved. Shorten it to the name in the state register.
create.countryHelp: It decides which legal forms are available, and it appears on the report.
create.countryRequired: Choose the country the company is registered in, so we know which legal forms to offer you.
create.contactEmailHelp: Where we write to you about this organisation. You can add it later under Organisation.
create.contactEmailInvalid: That is not the shape of an email address, so we could not write to it. Check the spelling — for example contact@company.md.
create.contactPhoneHelp: Any format. You can add it later under Organisation.
create.contactPhoneTooLong: The number is longer than 40 characters and cannot be saved. Leave only the phone number.
create.oneIsEnough: One organisation is enough to start. You add entities under it afterwards.
create.waitingForInvitation: Waiting for an invitation instead? Ask your administrator to invite this address.
create.problemTitle: The organisation could not be created
create.problemBody: The organisation was not created because the request could not be processed.

profile.title: Organisation profile
profile.lede: The legal identity printed on every report you file.
profile.pristine: Nothing changed yet — save stays inert until a value differs.

saved.title: Profile saved
saved.body: The new values apply to reports created from now on. Reports already filed keep the values in force when they were prepared.

profile.problemTitle: The change could not be saved
profile.problemBody: The profile is unchanged because the request could not be processed.

attribution.anonymous: Last changed {at}. The account that made the change no longer exists.

identity.heading: Legal identity
identity.lede: The name and legal form exactly as they appear in the state register.
identity.name: Legal name
identity.nameHelp: It prints on the report as you write it here.
identity.nameRequired: Enter the company’s legal name, or the profile cannot be saved.
identity.nameTooLong: The name is longer than 200 characters and cannot be saved. Shorten it to the name in the state register.
identity.countryHelp: It decides which legal forms we can offer you below.
identity.countryRequired: Choose the country the company is registered in, so we know which legal forms to offer you.
identity.legalFormHelp: Choose the form from the state register. You can leave it empty for now.

identifiers.heading: Entity identifiers
identifiers.lede: These reach the report and are checked by EFRAG’s own tooling at filing time.
identifiers.idnoHelp: The state identification number — 13 digits, from your registration certificate.
identifiers.idnoMalformed: The IDNO is not 13 digits, so it cannot be recorded. Retype it exactly as it appears on the registration certificate, without spaces.
identifiers.leiHelp: A 20-character international code, required by some banks and EU buyers. Most small Moldovan companies do not hold one — leave it empty if you do not.
identifiers.leiMalformed: The LEI is not 20 upper-case letters and digits, so it cannot be recorded. Retype it exactly as it appears on your LEI certificate.
identifiers.leiCheckDigits: The LEI’s check digits do not agree with the rest of the code, so the code is not valid. Check that you copied the right one.

address.heading: Registered address
address.lede: The company’s registered address, not the place you work from day to day.
address.lineTooLong: The line is longer than 200 characters and cannot be saved. Shorten it.
address.localityTooLong: The locality is longer than 120 characters and cannot be saved. Shorten it.
address.postalCodeTooLong: The postal code is longer than 20 characters and cannot be saved. Leave only the code.

contacts.heading: Contacts
contacts.lede: Two different contacts: one for us, one for the people who read the report.
contacts.platformEmailHelp: Where we write to you about this organisation. It does not appear in the report.
contacts.reportNameHelp: Who answers questions about the report’s content. It may be someone other than the account administrator.
contacts.reportEmailHelp: It appears on the cover and is seen by everyone who receives the report.
contacts.reportNameTooLong: The name is longer than 200 characters and cannot be saved. Shorten it.
contacts.emailInvalid: That is not the shape of an email address, so we could not write to it. Check the spelling — for example contact@company.md.
contacts.phoneTooLong: The number is longer than 40 characters and cannot be saved. Leave only the phone number.

permission.title: You do not have access to the organisation profile
permission.body: Only the organisation’s administrator can see and change these details. Your account holds a different role in this organisation.

unreachable.title: We could not load the profile
unreachable.body: The service did not answer, so the organisation’s details are not shown.
unreachable.action: Reload the page in a few moments.

entities.title: Reporting entities
entities.lede: Each entity reports separately. Its activity and sites decide which questions appear in the report.
entities.caption: The organisation’s entities

firstUse.title: You have no entities yet
firstUse.body: An entity is the company a report is prepared for. Without at least one you cannot open a reporting period.

filtered.title: No entity matches the filter
filtered.body: You have entities, but none has the status chosen above. Clear the filter to see them all.

permission.title: You do not have access to entities
permission.body: Only the organisation’s administrator can change entities. Your account holds a different role in this organisation.

unreachable.title: We could not load the entities
unreachable.body: The service did not answer, so the list is not shown.
unreachable.action: Reload the page in a few moments.

notFound.title: Entity not found
notFound.body: This address leads to no entity of this organisation. The address may have been edited, or the entity may belong to another organisation.

record.title: Entity
record.lede: The entity’s master data. Reports already filed keep the values in force when they were prepared.
record.createLede: An entity is the company a report is prepared for. You can fill it in gradually.

saved.title: Entity saved
saved.body: The new values apply to reports prepared from now on. Reports already filed keep the values in force when they were prepared.

record.problemTitle: The change could not be saved
record.problemBody: The entity is unchanged because the request could not be processed.

archived.title: Archived entity
archived.body: This entity’s data can no longer be changed. Its reports and exports remain available exactly as they were distributed.

identity.heading: Entity identity
identity.lede: The name and legal form as they appear in the state register.
identity.name: Entity name
identity.nameHelp: It prints on this entity’s report.
identity.nameRequired: Enter the entity’s name, or it cannot be saved.
identity.nameTooLong: The name is longer than 200 characters and cannot be saved. Shorten it.
identity.activityHelp: Type the activity’s name or its code. The activity decides which water and pollution questions appear in the report.
identity.activityPrompt: Start typing to search for an activity.
identity.activityEmpty: No activity matches. Try another word, or the code from your certificate.

boundary.heading: Reporting boundary
boundary.lede: It decides which figures enter the report: this entity alone, or its subsidiaries too.
boundary.basisHelp: The standard asks for an explicit answer, so we do not choose one on your behalf.

options.consolidated: Consolidated — the entity and its subsidiaries

boundary.memberNameRequired: Enter the subsidiary’s name, or the boundary cannot be saved.

sites.heading: Sites
sites.lede: The places the entity operates from. They decide the biodiversity questions.
sites.name: Site name
sites.nameRequired: Enter the site’s name, or it cannot be saved.

archive.title: Archive this entity?
archive.consequence: The entity leaves active selection: you can no longer open new periods for it and it stops appearing in lists. Its master data becomes uneditable.
archive.retained: Reports already filed and their exports remain available exactly as they were distributed. Nothing is deleted.

access.title: Users & access
access.lede: Who can see your organisation's ESG data, and what each person may do.
access.caption: People with access to this organisation

roleDescriptions.editor: Fills in and changes the report data.

firstUse.title: You are the only one with access so far
firstUse.body: Invite a colleague to fill the report in with you, or just to read it.

filtered.title: Nobody matches these filters
filtered.body: The filters you chose match nobody on the list. Clear them to see everyone again.

permission.title: This page is for organisation administrators
permission.body: Your account does not administer this organisation, so the list of people with access is not shown to you. Ask an administrator to make the change you need.

unreachable.title: The list could not be loaded
unreachable.body: We could not fetch the list of people with access. Nothing has changed in the meantime. Reload the page in a few moments.

invite.heading: Invite a colleague
invite.intro: We send a link that works for seven days. They choose their own password.
invite.emailRequired: Enter the email address of the person you are inviting, or the invitation cannot be sent.
invite.roleRequired: Choose the role this person receives, so they know what they may do once they accept.
invite.sent: The invitation has been sent to {email}.
invite.sentBody: They receive an email with a link that works for seven days. Until they accept, they appear on the list as invited.
invite.sentAction: You can send it again or withdraw it from the list above.
invite.failedAction: Find the person on the list above and choose what to do next.

actions.lastAdministrator: This is the organisation's only administrator.

remove.title: Withdraw this person's access?
remove.consequence: They lose access to every report in this organisation immediately, on every device.
remove.retained: What they entered stays in the change history, attributed to them.

revoke.title: Withdraw this invitation?
revoke.consequence: The link they were sent stops working from this moment.
revoke.done: The invitation for {email} has been withdrawn.

access.resent: We have sent the invitation to {email} again. The earlier link no longer works.
access.loading: Loading the list of people with access…

notice.body: The list above already shows the new situation.
notice.action: There is nothing further to do.
notice.failedAction: Try again, or reload the page.
